automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.rule: Include only public web sources published or visibly updated within the last 2 days relative to the run time. Exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, or boundary-only dates.

federation_boundary.local_scope: AI-assisted development practices, workflows, verification, governance, local adoption patterns, and downstream implementation implications.
federation_boundary.upstream_owned_scope: Companies, models, products, agentic frameworks, MCP servers, general developer tools, and broad techniques are owned by /Users/martinbechard/dev/ai-wiki/docs/wiki.
federation_boundary.collector_action: Entity updates are recorded as upstream-owned where applicable. Local notes capture only practice implications or routing decisions.

findings.title: Copilot Fast Mode preview changes model routing and review expectations
findings.summary: GitHub announced a preview Fast Mode for Claude Opus 4. The changelog says it is aimed at lower latency and cost while trading off some quality, and that organizations can use policy controls to enable or restrict it.
findings.why_it_matters: Coding-agent teams should treat faster model modes as an explicit operating choice with acceptance criteria, review depth, and cost policy rather than as a transparent default.
findings.local_practice_implication: Add model-mode selection to workflow-before-model-selection, verification-tax, and agent-cost-telemetry practices when the raw source is ingested.

findings.title: Copilot coding agent issue-creation restriction adds entry-point governance
findings.summary: GitHub announced a repository setting that can restrict Copilot coding agent from being started by issue assignment or mentioning Copilot in an issue, while still allowing starts from pull requests or Copilot Chat.
findings.why_it_matters: Agent delegation can be governed at the trigger surface. Teams need different approval boundaries for issue-based work intake, PR-based review, and chat-started tasks.
findings.local_practice_implication: Use this as raw evidence for human-agent-approval-boundaries and agent-identity-and-delegated-authority rather than creating a local GitHub product page.

findings.title: AI code review concern highlights review-gate erosion risk
findings.summary: Business Insider reported practitioner concern that AI-assisted coding can make traditional human code review less visible or less central in some teams.
findings.why_it_matters: The downstream practice question is not whether a specific editor is important, but how teams preserve review accountability, reviewer incentives, and regression ownership when agent-generated changes move faster than human review loops.
findings.local_practice_implication: Route to intelligent-code-review, code-review-evals-and-rubrics, and lifecycle-ai-review-gates as evidence for explicit human review checkpoints.

findings.title: Baz frames remediation agents around plan, patch, and validation loops
findings.summary: Baz announced an application-security remediation engine and described a workflow that plans fixes, updates code, and validates changes to reduce security backlogs.
findings.why_it_matters: Security repair agents should be modeled as constrained remediation workflows with traceable validation and backlog handoff boundaries, not just autonomous patch writers.
findings.local_practice_implication: Keep the entity upstream-owned and capture the local pattern under ai-assisted-security-repair-gates and research-plan-implement-review-lifecycle.

findings.title: Mozilla prompt-injection warning reinforces untrusted-context controls
findings.summary: Help Net Security summarized Mozilla 0DIN research on indirect prompt injection risk in AI coding agents, with emphasis on malicious instructions embedded in code or repository artifacts that the agent reads.
findings.why_it_matters: Source ingest, code retrieval, and tool execution must classify untrusted repository content separately from durable instructions and should require explicit controls before agents act on retrieved text.
findings.local_practice_implication: Use as evidence for prompt-injection-and-untrusted-content, rules-and-knowledge-layers, and tool-call-and-mcp-governance. Do not duplicate the broad prompt-injection technique page locally.

findings.title: CodeRabbit changelog adds review-flow actions and repository analysis surfaces
findings.summary: CodeRabbit's June 29 changelog listed review-flow improvements including interactive review actions and richer repository analysis surfaces.
findings.why_it_matters: AI code review tools are adding workflow-level affordances, so local review guidance should track what evidence is inspected, how comments become actions, and which review actions remain human-owned.
findings.local_practice_implication: Route product details upstream; keep downstream notes for intelligent-code-review and code-retrieval-evidence-patterns.

findings.title: Azure DevOps deployment incident is framed as an AI-coding governance lesson
findings.summary: DevClass reported on an Azure DevOps deployment incident and broader claims that AI coding tools can amplify delivery problems when process controls and verification are weak.
findings.why_it_matters: The practice implication is to tie AI-assisted changes to release gates, incident learning, and verification evidence rather than measuring agent productivity only by code volume or task completion speed.
findings.local_practice_implication: Use for prototype-to-cloud-promotion-gates, lifecycle-ai-review-gates, and product-judgment-quality-gates.

findings.title: Local-first coding-agent memory discussion points to MCP-mediated context control
findings.summary: A public Cursor forum post described a local-first persistent AI memory setup using MCP and knowledge graphs, with emphasis on avoiding cloud storage or login-based memory.
findings.why_it_matters: Even when the implementation is community-supplied, it captures a recurring practice pattern: teams want durable agent memory with local storage, explicit context boundaries, and governed tool mediation.
findings.local_practice_implication: Keep product and protocol details upstream; consider local practice coverage under compiled-wiki-and-structured-memory and tool-call-and-mcp-governance.
